name: list_my_approvals
title: List my approvals
description: What is waiting for the signed-in user's signature: purchase requests and orders, with value and who raised them.

ok.description: true when it worked; false comes with error and next_step

total.description: only when more are waiting than listed

has_more.description: only when more are waiting than listed (at most 50 are listed)

policy.on_busy_or_lost_reply: retry the read, at most 2 more times
policy.after_retries: ok=false, ledgerline_code ERR-SYS-0503 or TIMEOUT, with next_step

release_notes.1.1: 3 Nov 2026 (Lecture 4 production-grade pass): lists at most 50; when more are waiting it adds total, has_more and a note (1,000 pending made a 167 KB result).
